sources.title: OrcaRouter Ternary Bonsai 2 27B Uncensored - GitHub
sources.snippet: Runtime-uncensored Ternary Bonsai 2 27B — without modifying or re-quantizing the original weights by OrcaRouter research team. This repository applies refusal-direction ablation to prism-ml/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-mlx-2bit entirely at runtime.

sources.title: ldov/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-gguf · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A ternary value carries log₂3 ≈ 1.585 bits of information, so the effective storage cost of the format is ~1.71 bits/weight (ternary code + 16-bit scale amortized over 128 weights); counting the small set of tensors held above the ternary representation brings the model as a whole to 1.72 bits/weight — an idealized ~9.3x reduction vs FP16.

sources.title: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B - Bonsai - docs.prismml.com
sources.snippet: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B is the largest multimodal model in the family: it accepts vision input alongside text. It is based on Qwen3.8 27B, a hybrid-attention causal language model, and its matrix weights are ternary — values in {−1, 0, +1} in a fixed rotated basis, with FP16 group scales.
